title: Aquazone: Desktop Life Option Disc Series 4: Clown Loach
native_title: アクアゾーン・オプション・ディスク・シリーズ４ ～クラウン・ローチ～
overview: Aquazone: Desktop Life Option Disc Series 4: Clown Loach is a Sega Saturn simulation game released exclusively in Japan. It is not technically a game, but rather a tropical fish simulator.
